title: Telescope Hom comparison for a prescribed strict Koszul limit
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, O a sheaf of commutative rings, r a natural number (possibly zero), and b a Fin r-indexed list of global sections of O. Assume unbounded derived categories of O-module sheaves and of their strict natural-number inverse towers. Use the actual augmented Cech complex C_b, completion unit eta, strict Koszul tensor tower and presentation structure of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. For every specified RingedKoszulLimitPresentation D of that tower, there exists a natural isomorphism theta:RHom(C_b,-) ≅ D.completion such that eta_E followed by theta_E equals D.unit E for every derived object E. No existence of a presentation, slice restriction, uniqueness, coherence, or empty-list identity is included.

source.place: sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0A0A, lemma-colim-and-lim-of-duals; Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok; more-algebra.tex Tag 0913, lemma-extended-alternating-Cech-is-colimit-koszul; derived.tex Tag 0949, lemma-colim-hocolim

proof.text: 1. Take the augmentation-compatible colimit isomorphism alpha. Contravariant Hom of alpha followed by the ordinary-limit evaluation isomorphism gives a natural chain isomorphism v:Hom(Cech,-) ≅ lim T(-). The augmentation equation and the ordinary-limit unit equation identify inverse unit evaluation, augmentation precomposition and v with the actual ordinary-limit unit.

2. Use the canonical functorial K-injective resolution I and its quasi-isomorphism eta. The fixed localization factorization of derived internal Hom identifies Q followed by Cech completion with Q Hom(Cech,I(-)). Compose with v, D.comparison at T(I(-)), and the inverse of D.tensorFactors. The acyclicity lemma makes the middle comparison invertible. Finally invert D.completion(Q(eta)) to obtain an isomorphism Q followed by Cech completion ≅ Q followed by D.completion. Fully faithful precomposition by Q descends this natural isomorphism.

3. Naturality of the chain isomorphism and evaluation at one makes the ordinary-limit unit natural; combine with naturality of D.comparison and D.tensorFactors to show D.unitOnComplex is natural. Evaluate the descended isomorphism on the chosen representative of E. Naturality of the product-localization factorization moves augmentation precomposition past it; its inverse cancels the factorization. The ordinary-limit unit equation from step 1 replaces the remaining chain map. Naturality of D.unitOnComplex moves Q(eta) past the unit and cancels its inverse. Finally naturality of the descended comparison and of precomposition transports the equation along Q.objObjPreimageIso E, giving exactly D.unit E.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ringed_cech_koszul_hom_limit_comparison
    (D : RingedKoszulLimitPresentation O r b) :
    ∃ theta : ringedCechCompletionFunctor O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1 ≅ D.completion,
      ∀ E, ringedCechCompletionUnit O (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1
        (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2 E ≫ theta.hom.app E = D.unit E
